MAR.note: Article states no rule or authority on AI harms.

facts.fact: Morocco's National Financial Intelligence Authority (ANRF) has launched a tender to develop and deploy a secure multilingual AI platform with AI assistants, including a legal assistant, for its staff, sized for at least 100 simultaneous users.

MAR.note: Platform is for an authority's general administration, not a sector's public system.
Tender only; no model, dataset or AI computing built or in service is stated.
Data-control requirement is one authority's tender spec, not a government strategy, rule or hosting statement.
